title: Introducing the Fully Launched Spyglass Tool

summary: Enjoy effortless task management with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and seamlessly draggable for improved productivity.

summary: Unlock powerful new filtering and sorting options to precisely navigate your knowledge, and save your custom searches as personalized collections for instant, easy access.
